zh-CN.title: 主动解析与录音转写复用
items: 链接元数据长期保留，发送时首次解析；后续刷新需主动确认扣次，无元数据的链接气泡提供右侧解析入口。
录音实时转写结果随语音保存，再次转文字直接复用；未缓存的语音改用阿里识别。

en.title: Explicit link refreshes and reusable voice transcripts
items: Link metadata stays cached. Initial resolution happens on send; later refreshes require confirmation. Unresolved link bubbles have a Resolve button.
Live recording transcripts are saved with voice messages and reused. Uncached voice transcription now uses Aliyun.
